investigation_notes.Description: The alert shows 2,100 SharePoint file downloads from the user with sample files that include a SQL dump and encryption keys, which is ~52x their 24-hour baseline of 40. The activity occurred at 00:59 local time in Vienna and was performed using Python-urllib, indicating scripted access; the user's role as a junior developer/intern does not align with access to encryption keys and full database exports. There was a related alert earlier the same day for multiple failed login attempts for the same user, and given the timing, volume, sensitive file types, and role-to-data mismatch this activity is classified as High Priority.
